title: AWM: Answerable Working Memory for Long-Document VQA Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.25618v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-document visual question answering increasingly relies on VLM agents that retrieve candidate pages, inspect page images, write findings to working memory, and synthesize answers. Working memory should carry answer-supporting evidence across page inspections for later grounded answering, yet existing evaluation mainly checks final-answer correctness and evidence-page access. This creates a memory-quality blind spot: an agent may reach the right page and answer correctly while leaving behind memory too generic or incomplete to support answering once page context is removed. We introduce \emph{memory-only answerability}, a diagnostic that asks whether a reader can answer from the question and terminal working memory alone. translated_title: AWM：面向长文档视觉问答代理的可回答工作记忆
translated_abstract: 长文档视觉问答越来越依赖于视觉语言模型代理，这些代理检索候选页面、检查页面图像、将发现写入工作记忆并综合答案。工作记忆应在跨页面检查中携带支持答案的证据，以便后续进行有根据的回答，但现有评估主要检查最终答案的正确性和证据页面的访问。这造成了记忆质量的盲区：代理可能到达正确的页面并正确回答，但留下的记忆过于笼统或不完整，一旦移除页面上下文，就无法支持回答。我们引入了“仅记忆可回答性”这一诊断方法，它询问读者是否仅凭问题和终端工作记忆就能回答问题。基于这一诊断，“可回答工作记忆”（AWM）将终端工作记忆视为可回答的证据工件，而AWM-GRPO在保留最终结果的同时，将此信号纳入GRPO奖励中。
tldr: 本文提出AWM框架，通过引入“仅记忆可回答性”诊断和AWM-GRPO奖励机制，确保长文档视觉问答代理的工作记忆足以独立支持答案生成，填补了现有评估中忽视记忆质量的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AWM, which leverages a memory-only answerability diagnostic and AWM-GRPO reward to ensure working memory in long-document VQA agents independently supports answer generation, addressing the blind spot in existing evaluations regarding memory quality.
